test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st letter + 2 = 2nd letter**

**2nd letter + 3 = 3rd letter.**

Option 1) MOQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0ae49499a1dd670fb33b517811dc84333337ed13fb547d168032eab1a8280d1.png] 

**Not follow the same logic.**

Option 2) BDG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24ae35e2df8061613676ac0fbdcca3b72e9731dccc12aad4285b6a7eeadce75e.png] 

Follow the same logic.

Option 3) QSV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39fe7d798fdc7224a4041ab3952d43f74ea2e54789d561547c7c0b51fab40cd9.png] 

Follow the same logic.

Option 4) EGJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f98887901f8c97229af8f7fc526e0146b006f1c71c0e734d1b06ec6181719b4.png] 

Follow the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
